name: Framer landing page — AI design agent by framer.com
description: A near-black, cinematic product landing page that leads with a short statement headline and an embedded product demo, then alternates generous dark feature sections (each pairing a product screenshot with a small text block and CTA) before settling into a dense bento grid of platform capabilities. Colour is almost entirely black and white with blue/purple gradients reserved for product UI and one accent stat ("99.99% uptime"); full-colour photography only appears in the "Shipped with Framer" gallery, which creates strong rhythm through contrast. Typography is a single rounded geometric sans at very large scale for headings with small, low-contrast supporting copy, and the page ends with a functional chat-style input plus a compact multi-column footer.
